sourceFacts.fact: Fibroids arise from uterine smooth muscle and are described by relationship to the cavity and outer wall.
Submucosal, intramural and subserosal describe distinct locations.

forbiddenAnatomy: No invented labels, diagnostic imaging, patient likeness or unsupported precision.

validation.notes: Independent blind endpoint review identified the three masses, muscle wall, lining, cavity and cervical tissue. Cervical-tissue target is labelled Cervix, not canal. No exact FIGO subtype is claimed. Full-size and 375px inspected; v2 labels enlarged and shortened; all remain legible at phone width.
